_doc: Maps every docs/examples/**/*.json (generated by tools/extract_doc_examples.py) to the schema it must satisfy. Read by tools/validate_content.py, which fails on an example missing from this map or an entry whose file does not exist. Keys are paths relative to docs/examples/. Entry fields: schema = file stem under tools/schemas/ (null = no schema yet: parse-only, reason required); pointer = sub-schema the example is an instance of (default the whole schema); keyed_envelope = the example maps id -> entry body, each body is validated after adding id = key plus these envelope fields; fragment_member = the block is a bare '"key": value' member, validated as the value of that key after wrapping it in braces.
